title: ResetRequest
description: task_id always wins. Otherwise the split's task at index in ID order, at seed mod n, or a random one, leaving out tasks with coworkers unless coworkers is true. With max_seconds, a call that many seconds after the reset ends the episode as it stands instead of running. With coworkers, the client answers their turns with coworkers and coworker_reply frames; a task_id naming a task with coworkers needs it. Unknown fields are refused.
